page_title: LEV 1-2 CEL | Levante v Celta Vigo 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Mathew Ryan (Levante) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) has a shot from the edge of the box which goes past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. Oscar Mingueza provided the assistance with a headed pass. 1:2.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Julian Calero prepares a substitution. Carlos Alvarez is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
88' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Substitution. Manu Sanchez walks off the pitch and Alan Matturro (Levante) comes on as a substitute.
82' Here is a change. Jeremy Toljan is going off and Julian Calero gives the last tactical orders to Dela (Levante).
79' Jones El Abdellaoui comes onto the pitch because Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ilaix Moriba will be replaced by Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo).
77' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
69' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Ferran Jutgla will be replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
68' Here's the change. Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Kervin Arriaga (Levante) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
66' Levante will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

65' The ball is cleared after Etta Eyong (Levante) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Levante will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' That was close! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
60' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) replacing Marcos Alonso.
59' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) picks up a yellow card.
58' Substitution. Roger Brugue did his best and is replaced by Carlos Espi (Levante).
58' That was close by Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
56' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
51' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Celta Vigo get a corner.
50' The Celta Vigo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julian Calero probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Victor Garcia. He is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mathew Ryan makes a great save.
45+4' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
45+3' The corner from Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is cleared away by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
44' Victor Garcia (Levante) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
40' 0 - 1 Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot inside the right post. What a remarkable goal!
40' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.

40' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is in the right place at the right time to meet a rebound and attempts a header low towards the middle of the goal. Mathew Ryan is alert and denies him with a quick save. Celta Vigo have a corner.
38' Etta Eyong (Levante) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
38' Etta Eyong (Levante) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Levante are awarded a penalty kick!
36' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is about to take a corner kick.
36' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
33' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

33' A big opportunity is wasted by Etta Eyong (Levante), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, Ionut Radu pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Levante.
33' The free kick from long range, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
29' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Unai Vencedor (Levante). He’s got to go!

29' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Unai Vencedor (Levante), but referee Alejandro Quintero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
27' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Unai Vencedor (Levante), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
25' Celta Vigo try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
24' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick.
20' Alejandro Quintero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) and blew his whistle.
16' A cross from a corner kick by Levante is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

16' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Levante.

13' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Mathew Ryan guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
8' A crossfield pass from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.

5' Ambitious effort from Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
3' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
2' Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul after Victor Garcia (Levante) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Quintero.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
